text.en:
Upon finishing a reload within 3.8 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
25% Increased damage for 5 seconds.

Buff can be refreshed through additional reloads. Persists through stow.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 5.5 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
武器击杀后 3.8 秒内换弹：
+25% 伤害，持续 5 秒。

增益持续时间无法被再次换单而刷新。武器收起时保持生效。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间提升为 5.5 秒。
)
